Sets a mix of two scenes: every value that either holds, between the one of the first scene and the one of the second. Called every frame with a weight that follows the player, it crossfades from one place into another. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Walking into the cave: all outside at 20 units from the mouth, all cave at the mouth.
weight# = 1 - EntityDistance(camera, cave_mouth) / 20
BlendAudioScene outside, inside, weight, 20
```
@param scene_a  The scene at weight 0.
@param scene_b  The scene at weight 1.
@param weight  `0` is all of `scene_a`, `1` all of `scene_b`. Values outside are limited to that range.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the mix, `0` (the default) at once. About a frame keeps a crossfade smooth.
@gap A value that only one scene holds is mixed with its default: `1` for a bus volume, what [CreateListener](CreateListener) was given for rolloff, doppler and distance (1 without a listener), 340 for the speed of sound and 0 for the radius.
